pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with jagged, star-like edge gradients and high-contrast boundaries. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit larger spatial area, while patches transitioning toward the rear and limbs decrease in scale and increase in geometric complexity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological mesh of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank, narrowing slightly as the network ascends toward the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the upper cervical region. The silhouette of the mane creates a fine-grained, jagged profile against the background.
